describes: Current measurement page scales, calibration, mutations, readouts and lifecycle.

cases.name: reads-without-a-measure-service
cases.covers: Pages whose layouts carry no viewports read the metric default and are persistent (8bc6546e5). The reads: the scale (a page not in the document reads the loading scale), the twins, the busy flag, the last reports, the presets, the units and the area units, the pending request. measureDistance and measureArea convert page points through the page geometry and read the page scale; a page not in the document returns an unavailable readout. getReadout reads a dimension annotation and answers not-dimension for an unknown ref. ensureLoaded resolves at once for a page that is there and rejects not-found for a page not in the document.

cases.name: imperial-default-and-custom-presets
cases.covers: defaultScale 'imperial' makes the fallback 1:1 in feet, and presets replaces the picker. A preset whose paper length is not 1 divides the real length by it.

cases.name: custom-default-measure
cases.covers: A PdfMeasure as defaultScale is the fallback as it is, whatever the page userUnit; setPreset scales the ratio by the page userUnit.

cases.name: measure-service-viewports
cases.covers: Each page's layout carries its viewports (c7f8d75ff). An owned viewport wins wherever it is; otherwise the viewport under the page-space centre (the last containing one) is a foreign scale, one without a measure reads null, and a page whose viewports miss the centre falls back to the default. Every page is persistent. canMeasure is ready on each; a foreign scale gives readouts of foreign-measure.

cases.name: scale-events-move-the-layout
cases.covers: A page's scale comes with its layout, so canMeasure and ensureLoaded answer at once (8bc6546e5). A pages.scaleSet from another session moves the page's scale; stream.desynced reads the page list again and takes the scales it carries (a4805a492); document.versioned and an event whose layout keeps the same scales change none.

cases.name: set-scale-on-one-page
cases.covers: setScale writes the page's owned page-space 'EmbedPDF' viewport and the re-measure of the page's dimensions through the annotation plugin as one change: one pages.setScale op and the annotation updates (8bc6546e5). The page's scale follows the layout the engine answers, and the change is announced; isBusy is true while it runs and listLastReports keeps the reports. recalculate false writes the scale alone. clearScale drops the owned viewport and re-measures with the default. A single-page change rejects: a measure that is not writable, and a page not in the document.

cases.name: set-scale-on-several-pages
cases.covers: 'all' and a list of pages set every page's scale in one change, one pages.setScale op for the pages that get the same scale, with the re-measure of their dimensions, and report per page (8bc6546e5). A page whose scale fails before the change (a measure that is not writable, a scale without a rectilinear base) reports scaleError instead of rejecting. A list naming a page not in the document rejects not-found before anything is written, and so does a list of one page.

cases.name: set-scale-preflight
cases.covers: A single-page setScale runs the write preflight and rejects with its message: a conversion that is not positive, a precision that is not a whole number or is past the int32 range, a format whose unit is not a string, a text member that is not a string, a missing distance list, and an origin outside the PDF float range. A decimal format without a precision defaults to 100, and a label position, a fixed flag, a finite origin and a positive CYX all pass. calibrate writes the ratio rounded to eight significant digits.
cases.reason: Pins exact preflight refusals and successful scale recovery through calls and settlements.

cases.name: units-precision-and-presets
cases.covers: setUnit, setAreaUnit and setPrecision edit the page's rectilinear scale (the default counts) and write it back; a fractional last format restarts at a precision of 100. An invalid precision, a base unit that is not a length unit, and an unknown preset reject; setPreset writes the preset's ratio.

cases.name: service-writes-and-foreign-scales
cases.covers: A scale write is a change the engine applies, sent at once rather than queued behind the page's earlier change (8bc6546e5). A refused change rejects a single-page change, and the next change on that page still runs. Unit and precision edits need a rectilinear scale: a foreign one, or a viewport without a measure, rejects not-ready.

cases.name: calibration-flow
cases.covers: startCalibration clears any request and arms the calibrate tool. The tool's captured line becomes the pending request in page space (the pointer tool comes back, onCalibrationRequested fires); calibrate derives the scale from the known length, writes it, clears the request for its page and fires onCalibrationCompleted. A request on another page survives a calibrate elsewhere; dismissCalibration drops it and fires onCalibrationDismissed, and is silent with nothing pending. applyTo widens the write to one change over every page it names. Two identical points reject invalid-input; a page not in the document rejects not-found. A capture tool other than calibrate is ignored.

cases.name: zero-length-capture
cases.covers: A calibrate tool configured to click-create a zero-length line captures it, and a zero-length capture makes no request.

cases.name: without-authority
cases.covers: Read-only: canCalibrate and canMeasure are false, every scale change rejects permission-denied before touching a page, startCalibration throws permission-denied, and createMeasurement rejects permission-denied.

cases.name: create-measurement
cases.covers: createMeasurement creates a line (distance), a polyline (perimeter) or a polygon (area) through the annotation plugin, with the kind's own tool unless one is named. A distance needs exactly two points; a page not in the document rejects.

cases.name: listener-throws
cases.covers: A throwing listener goes to the kernel report channel with its exact Error; the change still resolves. An unsubscribed listener hears nothing more.

cases.name: pages-inserted-and-removed
cases.covers: A page inserted after the plugin connected brings its scale on its layout; a structural event that keeps the same pages changes no scale. A deleted page reads no scale, and a later change on it rejects not-found.

cases.name: page-removed-while-a-change-waits
cases.covers: A change that re-measures waits for the annotations to load. A page deleted meanwhile is still in the change it then sends; the engine refuses it, and the single-page change rejects with that refusal (not-found) and keeps no reports.

cases.name: close-mid-flight
cases.covers: Closing the document while changes run: the all-pages change resolves a serialized scale error for each page, the single-page change rejects instance-closed, and the attempted closed-state update reports instance-closed.
